sentences.text: Many wrong answers come from time arithmetic, not navigation.
Use the twenty-four hour clock, so one thirty in the afternoon is thirteen thirty.
When you add minutes, remember there are sixty minutes in an hour, not one hundred: nine forty-five plus fifty minutes is ten thirty-five.
Convert decimal hours by multiplying the decimal by sixty, so one point seven five hours is one hour forty-five minutes.
For trips with several legs, work out each leg’s time separately and add them.
